effect_description_eng:
When this card would be used, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, reduce the cost by 2.
[Main] By placing 1 [Peckmon] and 1 [Crowmon] from your trash as 1 of your [Falcomon]'s bottom digivolution cards, that Digimon may digivolve into [Ravemon] in the trash, ignoring digivolution requirements and without paying the cost.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] You may play 1 [Falcomon] or [Keenan Crier] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
